title: The Bhagavad Gita
style_lock: Premium high-quality charming painted comic / Amar Chitra mythology; warm cream-saffron-gold sacred hour on Kurukshetra; refined linework
style_master_ref: mood: cream-saffron-gold comic (do not attach Ep01 figure plate)
frame: Ornate lotus carved wooden frame on every plate

krishna.hair: Dark curly hair, peacock feather optional

arjuna.face: Noble warrior prince, dark mustache, same face every plate
arjuna.hair: Gold crown over dark hair (lock — not loose un-crowned hair)
arjuna.costume: Cream-white dhoti, gold belt, quiver on back, Gandiva — never flower garland

plates.beat_text: On the field of Kurukshetra two oceans of men stand ready — kin against kin.
must_show: Premium painted comic: vast battlefield Kurukshetra at dawn, two armies facing
Banners and ranks, equal natural human scale, no gore focus
plates.prompt: Premium painted comic Amar Chitra. Wide dawn view of Kurukshetra: two great armies facing across a dusty sacred plain, banners saffron and gold, distant chariots. Epic quiet before war. Equal human scale. Ornate lotus frame. Not photoreal.

plates.beat_text: Arjuna asks Krishna to drive between the armies, that he may see whom he must face.
must_show: Chariot with white horses; Krishna as charioteer; one Arjuna standing with bow
Arjuna gold crown, dark mustache, cream-white dhoti, quiver
plates.prompt: Premium painted comic Amar Chitra. Ornate two-horse chariot between two armies. Krishna in yellow pitambar holds the reins as charioteer. Exactly one Arjuna: gold crown, dark mustache, cream-white dhoti, quiver, Gandiva bow, looking toward the ranks. No Drona, no sage. Soft cream-saffron light. Ornate lotus frame. Not photoreal.

plates.beat_text: He sees teachers, cousins, friends — and his bow Gandiva slips from his hands.
must_show: Same Arjuna lock: gold crown, dark mustache, cream-white dhoti, quiver
One Arjuna grief-stricken on chariot; intact Gandiva slipping from his hands
plates.prompt: Premium painted comic Amar Chitra. Same two-horse chariot. Exactly one Arjuna — gold crown, dark mustache, cream-white dhoti, quiver — slumps in grief; intact Gandiva slips from his hands. Krishna in yellow pitambar holds the reins. No Drona, no sage, no second warrior. Soft golden dust light. Ornate lotus frame. Not photoreal.

plates.beat_text: Grief shakes the great archer. Krishna, calm as the sky, begins to speak.
must_show: Same Arjuna lock: gold crown, dark mustache, cream-white dhoti, quiver
Krishna turned toward Arjuna teaching calmly; Arjuna listening in grief
plates.prompt: Premium painted comic Amar Chitra. Same two-horse chariot. Krishna in yellow pitambar turns with serene smile, speaking, reins in one hand. Exactly one Arjuna — gold crown, dark mustache, cream-white dhoti, quiver — sits grieving but listening. No Drona, no sage. Soft sacred gold light. Ornate lotus frame. Not photoreal.

plates.beat_text: He teaches of the soul that is never slain, of duty without clinging to fruit.
must_show: Same Arjuna lock: gold crown, dark mustache, cream-white dhoti, quiver
Teaching moment: Krishna gesturing with calm authority; Arjuna attentive
Subtle soft glow of wisdom, not full cosmic form yet
plates.prompt: Premium painted comic Amar Chitra. Same two-horse chariot. Krishna teaches with open hand of dharma and a gentle halo. Exactly one Arjuna — gold crown, dark mustache, cream-white dhoti, quiver — looks up with understanding. No Drona, no sage, no third warrior. Cream-saffron sacred palette. Ornate lotus frame. Not photoreal.

plates.beat_text: At Arjuna’s prayer he shows the cosmic form — a universe of light upon the chariot.
must_show: Same Arjuna lock: gold crown, dark mustache, cream-white dhoti, quiver
Tasteful Vishvarupa: Krishna radiant multi-armed cosmic form of light on chariot — charming comic sacred awe NOT horror CGI
plates.prompt: Premium painted comic Amar Chitra. Same two-horse chariot. Krishna reveals a tasteful cosmic Vishvarupa above the chariot — many-armed radiant gold light, charming mythic style. Exactly one Arjuna — gold crown, dark mustache, cream-white dhoti, quiver — kneels in awe with joined hands. No Drona, no sage. NOT horror CGI. Ornate lotus frame. Not photoreal.

plates.beat_text: Doubt falls away. Arjuna takes up his bow again, mind steady in dharma.
must_show: Same Arjuna lock: gold crown, dark mustache, cream-white dhoti, quiver
Arjuna standing resolved, lifting Gandiva; Krishna smiling as charioteer
plates.prompt: Premium painted comic Amar Chitra. Same two-horse chariot. Exactly one Arjuna — gold crown, dark mustache, cream-white dhoti, quiver — stands firm lifting Gandiva ready (not overhead like a trophy). Krishna in yellow pitambar holds reins. No Drona, no sage. Soft gold hour. Ornate lotus frame. Not photoreal.

plates.beat_text: Conches sound across the field. The song is sung — and the war of ages begins.
must_show: Same Arjuna lock: gold crown, dark mustache, cream-white dhoti, quiver
Krishna sounding conch; Arjuna ready with bow; banners and armies responding
Epic opening of war without graphic gore
plates.prompt: Premium painted comic Amar Chitra. Same two-horse chariot. Krishna sounds the Panchajanya conch. Exactly one Arjuna — gold crown, dark mustache, cream-white dhoti, quiver — ready with bow. No Drona, no sage. Soft gold rings of sound. Ornate lotus frame. Not photoreal.

plates.beat_text: Thus on Kurukshetra the Bhagavad Gita was spoken — light before the storm.
must_show: Same Arjuna lock: gold crown, dark mustache, cream-white dhoti
Chariot silhouette or calm Krishna-Arjuna before golden field
plates.prompt: Premium painted comic Amar Chitra closing plate. Warm cream-saffron-gold Kurukshetra dawn; same two-horse chariot with Krishna charioteer and one crowned Arjuna small against a luminous sky. No Drona, no sage. Quiet epic light before the storm. Ornate lotus frame. Not photoreal.
